neighbours.label: the word 'municipality' / 'municipalities'
fire: Garbage collection is handled by the municipality twice a week.
Each municipality sets its own property tax rate.
The new bridge links two municipalities across the river.
Residents asked the municipality to repair the old playground.
Water bills are sent out by the municipality every quarter.
Three small municipalities merged their school boards last year.
A permit from the municipality is required to cut down a tree.
Rural municipalities often struggle to keep their clinics open.
quiet: Garbage collection is handled by the council twice a week.
Each province sets its own property tax rate.
The new bridge links two villages across the river.
Residents asked the mayor to repair the old playground.
Water bills are sent out by the utility every quarter.
Three small parishes merged their school boards last year.
A permit from the county is required to cut down a tree.
Rural towns often struggle to keep their clinics open.

notes: Probing: municipality 1.00, municipalities 0.89; county/district 0.14. Chinese city-name pieces ('zhou' 0.63, 京, 上海) also fire, so the token is the main but not the only trigger; the - pole is CJK city suffixes (市, 京都).
